verdict.rationale: Stripe Treasury is documented as a fully API-driven product with resources like FinancialAccount, OutboundPayment, ReceivedDebit, and Transaction objects, webhooks, and a build-an-integration guide, all accessible via the standard Stripe REST API plus CLI and MCP server support for programmatic access. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of API usage (e.g., a third-party developer report building against Treasury endpoints) and a direct OpenAPI spec link (probe found only 404s at candidate paths).
